claims.claim: RFC 8785 recursively sorts JSON object property names by unsigned UTF-16 code units, preserves array element order and encodes the canonical result in UTF-8.
RFC 8785 omits whitespace between JSON tokens and preserves Unicode string data without Unicode normalization.
Python's hashlib module supplies SHA-256, and a hash object's hexdigest method returns a hexadecimal text representation of the digest.
